# Synthetic font fixtures

These tiny test fonts are generated by `generate_fonts.py` with Python
FontTools. They contain hand-authored rectangle outlines and minimal tables;
they include no copied font outlines, glyph shapes, or other upstream font
assets. The same-name fixture is named `Noto Sans` deliberately, has a very
narrow `A`, and verifies that explicit caller-font selection wins over the
bundled face. The oversized fixture has a 100-unit `A` advance and a 30,000 by
30,000 font-unit outline, which exceeds the raster pixel budget at 512 px.

The script and generated fixtures are original test materials under the
repository's MIT license. They are not bundled in runtime builds.
